evidence: Titanium isopropoxide (TTIP) and (Ethylcyclopentadienyl) (1, 5-cyclooctadien) iridium (Ir(EtCp)(COD)) were used as Ti and Ir precursors, respectively. ... A unit-cycle for TiO2 was composed of TTIP vapor pulse with 50 cm3/min Ar carrier gas, a purge pulse with 50 cm3/min Ar, NH3 pulse with 25 cm3/min, and another 50 cm3/min Ar purge pulse, and a unit-cycle for IrO2 was composed of a Ir(EtCp)(COD) vapor pulse with 50 cm3/min Ar carrier gas, a purge pulse with 50 cm3/min Ar, a O2 pulse with 200 cm3/min, and another 50 cm3/min Ar purge pulse.
